entities.summary: Jessica Opare Saforo is a Ghanaian media personality, TV and radio broadcaster, and YouTuber entrepreneur. Also, she is the host of Transformation with Jess, Ghana's first-ever weight loss reality TV show. She is the owner of The Voice Ova Company, a business that specializes in managing voice talent.
